caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a mechanical or industrial component, centrally placed against a plain, textured beige background. The object consists of a circular wheel at the top, supported by eight evenly spaced spokes radiating from a central hub, and an outer rim that forms the perimeter of the wheel. The wheel is attached to a vertical column which has a vase-like, hourglass contour and is shaded in dark gray and black tones to suggest a metallic texture. The base of the column is rectangular and tiered, also depicted in dark gray with lighter highlights, giving a sense of form and volume. The composition is vertically oriented, and the entire object appears monochromatic, rendered predominantly in shades of black, gray, and white, contrasting with the light background. There is a small, neat signature in the bottom-right corner reading "M. Lim Lohnt."
title: Lottery Wheel
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
